ابتذلنا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلْنَا (ibtaḏalnā) /ib.ta.ðal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اُبْتُذِلْنَا (ubtuḏilnā) /ub.tu.ðil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
